mapper.select: SELECT r.menu_id,r.ingredient_id,COALESCE(p.product_name,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, p.supplier_product_id,p.supplier_item_code,o.provider_attributes FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN () cost ON cost.account_recipe_detail_id=r.account_recipe_detail_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_id=r.account_id AND ap.supplier_product_id=cost.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_offer_id=( SELECT so.supplier_offer_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer so JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss ON ss.supplier_account_site_id=so.supplier_account_site_id WHERE ss.account_id=r.account_id AND ss.active_yn='Y' AND so.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND so.active_yn='Y' AND (so.valid_from IS NULL OR so.valid_from<=CURRENT_DATE) AND (so.valid_to IS NULL OR so.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY so.last_synced_at DESC,so.supplier_offer_id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} ORDER BY r.menu_id,r.ingredient_seq

SELECT #{account_id} account_id,ai.ingredient_id, COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_std) ingredient_name_std,COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name_raw, COALESCE(ai.category_name,i.category_name) category_name,ai.base_unit,COALESCE(ai.storage_type,i.storage_type) storage_type, COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, usage_rows.menu_usage_count,p.product_name,p.supplier_product_id,s.supplier_name FROM (SELECT rd.ingredient_id,COUNT(DISTINCT rd.menu_id) menu_usage_count FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m ON m.account_id=rd.account_id AND m.menu_id=rd.menu_id AND m.del_yn='N' WHERE rd.account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY rd.ingredient_id) usage_rows JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=#{account_id} AND ai.ingredient_id=usage_rows.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=usage_rows.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=( SELECT a.account_ingredient_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product a JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product product ON product.supplier_product_id=a.supplier_product_id WHERE a.account_id=#{account_id} AND a.active_yn='Y' AND product.active_yn='Y' AND a.mapped_ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id ORDER BY a.preferred_yn DESC,a.mod_at DESC,a.account_ingredient_product_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id ai.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} ORDER BY ingredient_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master(account_id,ingredient_id,ingredient_name_raw,ingredient_name_std,category_name,base_unit,storage_type,needs_review,note,active_yn,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{ingredient_id},#{ingredient_name_raw},#{ingredient_name_std},#{category_name},#{base_unit},#{storage_type},COALESCE(#{needs_review},0),#{note},COALESCE(#{active_yn},'Y'),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ingredient_name_raw=VALUES(ingredient_name_raw),ingredient_name_std=VALUES(ingredient_name_std),category_name=VALUES(category_name),base_unit=VALUES(base_unit),storage_type=VALUES(storage_type),needs_review=VALUES(needs_review),note=VALUES(note),active_yn=VALUES(active_yn),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id} AND meal_plan_type=#{meal_plan_type} AND del_yn='N' ORDER BY menu_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master(account_id,menu_id,menu_name_raw,menu_name,food_type,food_type_reason,menu_type,menu_gubun,meal_plan_type,calories_per_serving,del_yn,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{menu_id},#{menu_name_raw},#{menu_name},#{food_type},#{food_type_reason},#{menu_type},#{menu_gubun},COALESCE(#{meal_plan_type},0),#{calories_per_serving},COALESCE(#{del_yn},'N'),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE menu_name_raw=VALUES(menu_name_raw),menu_name=VALUES(menu_name),food_type=VALUES(food_type),food_type_reason=VALUES(food_type_reason),menu_type=VALUES(menu_type),menu_gubun=VALUES(menu_gubun),meal_plan_type=VALUES(meal_plan_type),calories_per_serving=COALESCE(VALUES(calories_per_serving),calories_per_serving),del_yn=VALUES(del_yn),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master SET del_yn='Y',user_id=#{user_id},mod_at=NOW() WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id}
mapper.select: SELECT base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master WHERE ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}

SELECT r.*,i.ingredient_name_std FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=r.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND r.menu_id=#{menu_id} AND r.recipe_id=#{recipe_id} ORDER BY r.menu_id,r.ingredient_seq
SELECT MIN(recipe_id) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail(account_id,recipe_id,menu_id,ingredient_id,ingredient_seq,ingredient_name_raw,qty_raw,qty_num,qty_unit,recipe_yield_servings,qty_base,base_unit,qty_per_person,review_flag,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{recipe_id},#{menu_id},#{ingredient_id},COALESCE(#{ingredient_seq},1),#{ingredient_name_raw},#{qty_raw},#{qty_num},#{qty_unit},#{recipe_yield_servings},#{qty_base},#{base_unit},#{qty_per_person},CASE WHEN #{review_flag} IS NULL OR #{review_flag}='' OR #{review_flag}='0' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ingredient_id=VALUES(ingredient_id),ingredient_name_raw=VALUES(ingredient_name_raw),qty_raw=VALUES(qty_raw),qty_num=VALUES(qty_num),qty_unit=VALUES(qty_unit),recipe_yield_servings=VALUES(recipe_yield_servings),qty_base=VALUES(qty_base),base_unit=VALUES(base_unit),qty_per_person=VALUES(qty_per_person),review_flag=VALUES(review_flag),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT supplier_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product WHERE supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND supplier_item_code=#{supplier_item_code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product(account_id,supplier_product_id,mapped_ingredient_id,preferred_yn,safe_stock_base_qty,max_stock_base_qty,lead_time_days,default_location_id,active_yn,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{supplier_product_id},#{ingredient_id},COALESCE(#{preferred_yn},'N'),COALESCE(#{safe_stock_base_qty},0),#{max_stock_base_qty},COALESCE(#{lead_time_days},0),COALESCE(NULLIF(#{location_id},''),'L999'),'Y',#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE preferred_yn=VALUES(preferred_yn),safe_stock_base_qty=VALUES(safe_stock_base_qty),max_stock_base_qty=VALUES(max_stock_base_qty),lead_time_days=VALUES(lead_time_days),default_location_id=VALUES(default_location_id),mapped_ingredient_id=COALESCE(mapped_ingredient_id,VALUES(mapped_ingredient_id)),active_yn='Y',user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT account_ingredient_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND supplier_product_id=#{supplier_product_id}
